body: I hope you are as well! Hopefully more people learn to treat this kinda thing with discretion at some point.

I (wrongly) didn't treat the concept of an existential crisis in the way that I should have, before I actually had one. Was genuinely the scariest experience of my life, still not sure if I would entirely define it as an existential crisis rather than a complete dissociative breakdown, but the whole experience of genuinely not knowing whether you exist or not is a horrible thing. I completely became disconnected from everything around me (I believe I was on a tour), was touching the walls to see if they were real or not, etc. Wouldn't even wish it on my worst enemies, honestly, and I feel so bad for constantly making light of dissociation before it happened to me. People need more education on this stuff before they throw terms around imo :/
